*Hetuduka, Pītittika* (Patthana 15.7) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna section of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. As designated by its title, the text examines conditional relations through the analytical combination of the root dyad (*hetuduka*) with the rapture triad (*pītittika*) [SuttaCentral].
No external parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are recorded for this text [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis by DharmaNexus indicates extensive internal text reuse within the Paṭṭhāna, showing 79 matching passages across 32 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial textual overlaps occur with related combinatory sections of the Paṭṭhāna, including *Hetuduka, Mahantaradukādi* (Patthana 18.7), *Hetuduka, Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 24.6), *Hetuduka, Vitakkattika* (Patthana 21.21), *Hetuduka, Atītārammaṇattika* (Patthana 21.34), and other treatments of the same matrices such as *Hetuduka, Pītittika* (Patthana 21.22) and *Pītittika* (Patthana 13.7) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
